messages:
mike: quick probe on a "last-mile" epilogue fusion idea for fused attention — tried collapsing bias+rotary into the post-attn epilogue when we do packed qkv. rough numbers below, curious if others see the same.
elaine: drop the numbers? seq/batch/config please.
mike: ran on A100, torch dev build, flash-variant A/B/C. seq=1024, batch=4, kv_paged=false for initial. ran with and without epilogue-fuse flag. command: `./bench_attn --kernel flash_v2 --packed-qkv --epilogue-fuse`

mike: ```
# flash_v2 baseline (no epilogue fuse)
seq=1024 b=4 tokens=4096
latency: 28.6ms
throughput: 142 tok/ms

# flash_v2 + epilogue-fuse (packed qkv + bias+rotary)
latency: 24.9ms  (-12.9%)
throughput: 163 tok/ms

# flash_v1 + epilogue-fuse (control)
latency: 26.5ms  (-7.3%)
```

raj: interesting. did you try with paged KV? my hunch is the fused epilogue hurts when we do on-demand page pulls (L2/L1 reorder).
mike: yes — enabling paged-kv + same fuse made latency go up for seq>512. quick paste:

mike: ```
# flash_v2 + epilogue-fuse + paged-kv(page_size=64KB)
seq=1024 b=4
latency: 30.8ms (+24%) vs baseline paged-kv baseline 24.8ms
# profile shows heavy L2 miss rate and scattered stores in epilogue
```

raj: yup. flamegraph: https://ci.perf/reports/2315/lastmile-epilogue (internal). looks like the fused epilogue does a lot more non-coalesced writes when KV pages are hot-swapped.
suz: :eyes: could be a memory-ordering issue — epilogue writes interleave with KV page pulls, causing stalls. maybe split epilogue into two paths: cached-path (fast fused) and uncached-path (sequential-friendly).
elaine: agree. alternative: keep fusion but add a small prefetch window that ensures KV pages touched before final stores. that reduces thrash in my microtests.

mike: proposal for microbench sweep:
- vary page_size: [16KB, 64KB, 256KB]
- batch: [1,4,8]
- seq: [128,512,1024,2048]
- kernel chooser: try thresholds (fuse if seq*batch < T)
- metrics: p50/p95 latency, L2 miss rate, store coalescing ratio

mike: example kernel-chooser tweak (pseudo-config):
```
kernel_selection:
  fused_epilogue: true
  fused_threshold_tokens: 4096   # fallback to unfused if tokens > threshold
  prefer_cached_path_when: "paged_kv.enabled && predicted_page_fault_rate > 0.02"
```
